text:
tae: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: the reliability incident. two asks from leadership: RCA link and a concise owner/action list for tracking.

nora: RCA live -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-2026-45. short: degraded KV cache eviction under load caused policy-router misrouting and cascading retries.

sam: i'll own immediate mitigation: backfill cache capacity + conservative eviction thresholds. plan: canary patch + smoke within 24h. will post updates to #eng-sre.

vik: i'll implement a config validation guard behind a flag to prevent bad hash switches from reaching prod. target: 18h.

maria: leadership asked about customer comms. i'll draft a one-paragraph customer note and post for review by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: incident-record 2026-09-02T15:12Z added to incident log.

tae: i've added the actions to the ops sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/action-tracker (row 219). snapshot: 1) canary cache bump (owner: sam) due 24h; 2) config guard flag (owner: vik) due 18h; 3) customer note draft (owner: maria) due EOD next day; 4) arch follow-up (owner: eng-runtime) due next sprint.

sam: snippet for rollback/check in RCA for oncall:
```
# scale cache pods
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy/cache --replicas=6
# validate cache hit rate
curl -s http://local-metrics/cache | jq .hit_rate
```

nora: can we get a single-slide postmortem for next all-hands? leadership wants impact + next steps.
tae: yes — sam + vik please co-author the slide; i'll add to the deck. deadline 72h.

maria: will coordinate customer comms review with @tae when draft is ready. :eyes:

sam: i'll drop short status updates in this thread every 12h until closed.
tae: thanks all — quick sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. invites sent.
